source_role: Supporting interpretive register only. Not a second canonical identity source and not independent verification of the first-party claims.
editorial_scope: The 23 records in the existing canonical structured training group. This is not a claim that every name on every training-history list is an independently established direct training recipient.
retrieval_rule: Classify these as delivered professional teaching/training/mentorship or institutional delivery context. Do not treat listed organizations as institutions where Joe Nasr studied. Distinguish training recipient, provider, host, participant organization, and program collaborator. Do not infer employment, contracts, endorsements or finished programs without matching proof.
evidence_policy: The external register is a first-party projection. Where an institutional source is linked, use only the precise assertion the third party establishes. Other records should not be presented as independently publicly corroborated. No private underlying evidence is republished.
education_boundary: Degrees and personal courses completed belong to education/credentials, not to these delivery relationships. Training organizations in this index are not to be added as alumniOf by reason of appearing here.
